## Build

The build entry point is `Makefile` at the repository root, and it provides an `install` target.

```bash
make
sudo make install
```

## Dependencies

`Build-Depends` in `debian/control` lists 50 entries; the first 8 are listed below (see `debian/control` for the complete list):

- `dde-api-dev (>> 3.17.1+)`
- `debhelper-compat (= 11)`
- `velora-desktop-schemas`
- `deepin-gettext-tools`
- `golang-github-linuxdeepin-go-lib-dev (>> 5.1.0+)`
- `golang-gir-gio-2.0-dev (>> 1.2.0+)`
- `golang-gir-glib-2.0-dev (>> 1.2.0+)`
- `golang-gir-gobject-2.0-dev (>> 1.2.0+)`
